start.confirm_email: You're signing in as {email} — is that you?
start.invite_declined: Okay, sign-in cancelled. Ask for a new link if you need one.
start.invite_conflict: This Telegram is already linked to someone else. We don't merge accounts — ask whoever invited you.
start.consent: Taskano stores your tasks, time and work messages to guide you step by step. Agree?
start.login_prompt: Enter the email linked to Taskano.
start.email_invalid: That doesn't look like an email. Example: ahmet@example.com
start.code_sent: Code sent to {email}. Enter it here.
start.code_wait: A code has already been sent. You can request a new one in a minute.
start.closed: Taskano is an internal tool: sign-in is by invitation only. If you were invited, open the link in the invitation email.
start.code_invalid: Code didn't match. Check it and send again.
start.unknown: I don't know you yet. Send /start.
language.ask_switch: Looks like another language suits you better — switch?
language.changed: Done, I'll write in this language from now on.
card.author: Set by: {text}
btn.question: Question
result.ask_text: To hand this in, send what was done as text — at least {min} characters.
result.ask_number: To hand this in, send a number.
result.ask_photo: To hand this in, send a photo.
result.ask_file: To hand this in, send a photo or write where the file is (a link) — at least {min} characters.
result.ask_number_plain: Write the number without thousands separators — for example 1500 or 3.5.
comment.ask: What should be noted on this one?
comment.limit: That is enough notes on this one for today. Let's continue tomorrow.
comment.too_long: That is too long. Write the gist in a couple of sentences — details belong in the task itself.
decline.ask_reason: Why decline? A reason is required.
proposal.changed: Noted, the agent will pick it up.
notif.not_acknowledged: {name}: the task is not picked up yet
notif.runner_broken: The agent can't reach its executor
notif.ai_budget_exceeded: Monthly translation budget is used up
notif.read_token_issued: A token for programs was issued
notif.read_token_issued_body: Not you? Revoke it in the app: “Access for programs”.
notif.agent_token_issued: An agent token was issued for {agent}
notif.agent_token_issued_body: Not you? Revoke it in the app: “Access for programs”.
notif.external_overdue: The wait deadline has passed, still no answer
notif.agents_silent: The agent has been quiet longer than usual
notif.stuck_summary: Plans with no movement for a week: {count}
notif.open_app: {name} asks you to open the Taskano app
notif.open_app_body: All your tasks in “{org}” are there.
notif.review_reminder: Result from {name} has waited for your decision: {hours} working hours
notif.review_overdue: {reviewer} has not reviewed the result from {name}
notif.review_overdue_body: Waiting for a decision for {hours} working hours.
notif.person_offboarded: {name}: no longer in the organization, task cancelled
notif.due_request_reminder: The due date is still not named
notif.due_request_body: {name} is asking. Pick a date with the button below.
notif.due_request_body_plain: Pick a date with the button below.
notif.due_set_from_chat: Due date recorded from your message in “{chat}”: {date}
notif.timer_autostopped_day_end: The timer stopped at the end of your working day: {minutes} min recorded. Start it again when you continue.
notif.timer_autostopped_idle: The timer stopped after 3 hours without activity: {minutes} min recorded. If you worked longer, add the time manually.
take_prompt.later_done: Okay, I will remind you at {time}.
take_prompt.later_exists: A reminder is already set — for {time}.
take_prompt.already_taken: This task is already in progress.
menu.home_screen: Tip: open the app, use the “…” menu in the top right corner and choose “Add to Home Screen” — a Taskano icon appears next to your other apps, and your task list opens in one tap.
hint.no_tasks_here: Tasks aren’t added here — the agent assigns them. Your to-do list: the «Open app» button left of the input field.
group.connected: Group “{title}” is connected. The bot collects photos and facts for tasks and does not post in the group.
group.make_admin: Make the bot an administrator of “{title}” — otherwise it can't see messages. No permissions are needed.
group.pick_org: Which organization should “{title}” be connected to?
group.left_not_allowed: I left “{title}”: only an owner or admin of a company in Taskano can connect a group.
group.pick_stale: This choice is no longer valid.
notif.maybe_done: Looks like it is done — mark it?
group.secretary_description: Creates tasks from work group chats when an assignment fits none of the directions.
group.task_proposal: From group “{group}” — a task over the daily limit: {name}: {title}. Create it?
group.task_how_default: There were no details in group “{group}” — ask whoever set this before you start.
dialog.which_task: Which task is this message about?
dialog.not_awaited: The bot is not waiting for a reply to that message. To answer about a task, reply to its prompt or press a button on its card.
invite.act_first: This task is from a company you have been invited to. To start working there, take the task or reply about it.
photo.ask: Send a photo or a screenshot for this task.
photo.which_task: Which task should it go to?
photo.no_open_tasks: There are no open tasks — nowhere to attach the photo.
photo.only_images: For now only photos and screenshots can be attached.
photo.closed: The task is closed — a photo cannot be attached.
photo.fetch_failed: Could not get the photo, please send it again.
photo.unsupported: This image does not open. Send it as a regular photo or a screenshot.
photo.too_big: The file is larger than 20 MB — send a smaller photo.
photo.limit: That is enough photos on this task for today. Let us continue tomorrow.
notif.task_photo: {name} attached a photo to the task
notif.announcement_reminder: Reminder: please confirm the announcement from {name}
notif.announcement_reminder_via: Reminder: please confirm the announcement from {name} via the agent {agent}
